mandate: Assess whether mapped tests plausibly establish each assigned acceptance criterion.
assessment_method: Inspect prepared test and implementation references.
Classify layers and assertion, boundary, and overall adequacy.
Identify negative, recovery, transition, and mock-boundary gaps.
forbidden_claims: passing test command proves criterion coverage
new shell output closes a graph gap
completion_rules: Return exactly one disposition per assigned criterion.
Cite only prepared test, graph, or role-bound packet-source references.
Packet-source references remain model-reviewed provenance and are not proof.
Keep all adequacy conclusions model_reviewed or not_inspected.

adequate: The component test asserts persisted state and public response content but lacks a recovery assertion, so overall adequacy is partial.
inadequate: The filename mentions publish, so it covers publishing.
